name: Garlic

basicInfo.description: Garlic is a low-maintenance crop that rewards you with flavorful bulbs. It’s planted once and grows steadily over several months, making it ideal for beginners.
whyGrow: Essential kitchen ingredient with strong flavor
Stores well for months after harvest
basicInfo.water: Moderate watering, keep soil evenly moist but not soggy

growingSteps: Break a garlic bulb into individual cloves
Plant cloves 5cm deep with pointed side up in well-drained soil
Mulch to conserve moisture and suppress weeds
Harvest when lower leaves turn brown and tops begin to fall over

careCalendar.description: Place cloves pointed side up 5cm deep.
Apply a layer of mulch to keep soil moist and suppress weeds.
Remove weeds around garlic plants to reduce competition.
Pull garlic when leaves yellow and tops fall over.

harvestingGuide: Harvest garlic when 2/3 of leaves have yellowed. Gently loosen soil and pull bulbs. Cure by drying in a shaded, airy place for 2–3 weeks before storage.
estimatedSavings: Growing garlic can save $40–80 per year, since supermarket garlic can be costly compared to a few homegrown bulbs that multiply easily.
